propositions: Rebar's reconciler hardcodes Jira project workflow mappings (status, type, link relations, priority) in three separate files, preventing support for projects with variant workflows without core edits.
A config-driven mapping seam layered from built-in defaults → config default block → per-project overlay must replace hardcoded maps while preserving backward compatibility.
Non-allowed transitions must be resolved by replaying recorded hop sequences from the ticket's core STATUS event log, failing to drift only when no recorded trail survives (e.g., compacted tickets).
Non-representable parent relationships must drift with an echo-safe breadcrumb comment naming the nearest represented ancestor's Jira key.
The mapping core must be provider-neutral with all Jira specifics isolated to the adapter, verified by absence of Jira literals and imports in core modules.

Config-driven mapping seam is complete across all axes (S1-S10): status, type, link relations, priority, transition replay, parent breadcrumbs, suggest-mapping command, and doctor diagnostics are implemented and merged.
